findings.title: Issuer proof validation
findings.originalTitle: Credential import accepts invalid issuer signatures
findings.change: Imports verify Ed25519 did:key issuer signatures, holder binding, supported algorithms and JWT time bounds before saving. Library copy distinguishes signature checks from live trust/status checks.
findings.validation: 12 wallet tests; forged signature rejection; real issuer/browser/verifier contract.

findings.title: Issuer disclosures preserved
findings.originalTitle: Decrypting a claim creates a disclosure the issuer never signed
findings.change: Encrypted disclosures retain their original bytes. Selected content keys are bound to disclosure digests inside the signed KB-JWT TrustWeave extension. The verifier authenticates the presentation before decrypting.
findings.validation: Real encryption regression checks exact disclosure bytes, digest membership, selected key release, and no key for withheld claims.

findings.title: Selective disclosure stays explicit
findings.originalTitle: Multiple SD-JWT credentials fall into the full-disclosure path
findings.change: Multi-credential presentations containing SD-JWT credentials are refused. Missing/duplicate IDs fail, and selective claims start unchecked.
findings.validation: Concurrent-import and multi-SD-JWT rejection regression; actual verifier checks only selected claims.

findings.title: Cloud failures propagate
findings.originalTitle: Cloud listing hides storage and status-resolution errors
findings.change: Cloud list/statistics fail on storage/filter errors. Recovery is explicit, includes per-record failures, and propagates cancellation.
findings.validation: CloudRecoveryTest and existing cloud plugin suites.

findings.title: Cloud storage handles exposed
findings.originalTitle: Anonymous cloud credentials still lose their discoverable storage handle
findings.change: CloudWallet implements CredentialRecordStorage and returns storage IDs independently of signed VC IDs.
findings.validation: Cloud plugin tests; stored-key reconstruction in listRecords/recovery.

findings.title: Bounded database paging
findings.originalTitle: Database queries now materialize every credential
findings.change: New cursor capability bounds page sizes to 1-500 and preserves continuations for empty filtered pages. PostgreSQL uses indexed JSON containment for issuer/type/subject predicates. Legacy List behavior remains explicit.
findings.validation: 1,002-record H2 pagination regression and real PostgreSQL filtering/index-plan test pass. Production-scale performance benchmarking remains outside this local run.

findings.title: Explicit file recovery
findings.originalTitle: File listing presents partial recovery as a complete result
findings.change: Normal listings, record listings and statistics consistently fail on corrupt credentials or metadata; recoverRecords reports partial data explicitly.
findings.validation: File corruption/recovery and existing file-wallet tests.

findings.title: Record mutations serialized
findings.originalTitle: Atomic replacement does not coordinate delete and metadata
findings.change: Store/delete coordinate credential and metadata locks in stable order across wallet instances in the same JVM. Atomic replacement remains in use.
findings.validation: File wallet regression suite; record lock ordering reviewed. Cross-process distributed filesystem transactions are not claimed.

findings.title: Origin-wide browser locking
findings.originalTitle: Credential writes are not serialized across tabs
findings.change: Bootstrap, imports, signing, deletion and reset share a Web Lock. Facade mutations are asynchronous; callers await them.
findings.validation: Real Chromium tabs concurrently import without lost updates; reload preserves both records and signing identity.

findings.title: Stored data validated
findings.originalTitle: Current-schema data is cast without runtime validation
findings.change: Credential collections and holder metadata receive runtime validation. Malformed data enters recovery without replacement; the Share page now displays recovery correctly.
findings.validation: Malformed JSON-shape regressions and production-page recovery browser test.

findings.title: Catalog-backed requirements
findings.originalTitle: Capability checks and the catalog remain separate sources of truth
findings.change: Runtime metadata can be generated from the capability catalog. Registry application requirements validate assessed operations; format checks fail closed. Assessed stub providers refuse construction; docs enumerate unassessed modules.
findings.validation: Common capability/registry tests and generated documentation drift check.

findings.title: Real browser contracts
findings.originalTitle: Browser custody and cross-profile flows lack end-to-end coverage
findings.change: Added Chromium coverage for issuer/import/disclosure/verifier contracts, nonce failure, persistent non-extractable keys, cross-tab writes and recovery. CI runs these after building.
findings.validation: 3 Chromium tests and 12 wallet unit/crypto tests pass. Custody and custom encrypted-profile limits are documented.

findings.title: Wallet dependencies updated
findings.originalTitle: Reference-wallet dependency graph has unresolved advisories
findings.change: Next.js, Vite, Vitest and browser-test tooling updated; dynamic route parameters migrated. Node 24 is the supported CI/runtime baseline.
findings.validation: Wallet audit reports 0 vulnerabilities; production build and typecheck pass.

findings.title: Legacy lookup removed
findings.originalTitle: Public legacy redemption exposes credentials without proof of possession
findings.change: Public credential IDs no longer expose expected holder IDs or raw credentials. Staged invitations and proof-bound OID4VCI remain the retrieval routes.
findings.validation: PublicCredentialOfferSecurityTest covers attacker and known-holder guesses without touching the credential repository.

findings.title: Offer redemption locked
findings.originalTitle: An offer can be redeemed concurrently through multiple grants
findings.change: A pessimistic database lock serializes redemption of one offer across calls while status and issuance are processed.
findings.validation: Backend compilation/integration validation; locked repository query used by the transactional redemption service.

findings.title: Resource audience required
findings.originalTitle: azp bypasses the intended API audience requirement
findings.change: Validation requires aud; azp cannot substitute. Blank audience configuration fails startup. Keycloak integration fixtures now add the API audience mapper.
findings.validation: AudienceValidatorTest and authenticated Keycloak controller integrations.

findings.title: Policy switches explicit
findings.originalTitle: Adding a trusted issuer changes disabled checks back to enabled
findings.change: The verification DSL explicitly calls skipRevocation/skipExpiration when disabled, including allowlist verification.
findings.validation: Credential verifier and policy tests; complete backend suite.

findings.title: Unchecked is not passed
findings.originalTitle: Unchecked expiry and revocation are reported as passing checks
findings.change: Verification checks carry an evaluated flag. Disabled expiry/revocation/trust checks are shown as not evaluated, including neutral frontend indicators.
findings.validation: Frontend build/tests and backend verifier policy tests.

findings.title: Strict trust fails closed
findings.originalTitle: Strict verification silently relaxes issuer trust when the list is empty
findings.change: Strict verification refuses to produce a valid result when no trusted issuer can be evaluated.
findings.validation: Regression now expects a failed Strict result with a trusted-issuer configuration error.

findings.title: Disclosure limitations honest
findings.originalTitle: The request requires selective disclosure while accepting whole JSON credentials
findings.change: The full-JSON profile requests preferred disclosure and communicates complete-credential disclosure in metadata and UI.
findings.validation: Verification request tests and frontend build.

findings.title: History paging and retention
findings.originalTitle: Verification history causes unbounded N+1 read/write work
findings.change: Tenant history returns a bounded Page with no per-row writes. A history index supports ordering. Configurable 90-day retention deletes at most 500 expired records hourly.
findings.validation: History paging, retention cutoff and database purge tests; V22 migration.

findings.title: Server-side cancellation
findings.originalTitle: Cancel only dismisses the operator’s local view
findings.change: Tenant-authorized cancellation becomes a terminal database state. The UI posts cancellation and uses the server result rather than only clearing local state.
findings.validation: Cancellation regression rejects later submission and checks tenant isolation; frontend tests/build.

findings.title: Verification work bounded
findings.originalTitle: Presentation cost is not bounded by credential count or concurrency
findings.change: Byte, depth, descriptor and credential-count bounds precede cryptography. Per-instance/per-tenant worker limits, a 15-second deadline and a 30-second database lease bound and deduplicate work.
findings.validation: Work gate duplicate/deadline tests and session regressions; deployment shared ingress quotas still require staging validation.

findings.title: Webhook failures recoverable
findings.originalTitle: Undeserializable subscription events are permanently acknowledged
findings.change: Unsupported signed subscription events return retryable failures, retain the verified payload in a recovery table, and do not keep a successful dedup marker. Successful retry removes recovery data.
findings.validation: Updated Stripe controller tests pass; V23 migration and privileged-operator recovery runbook.

findings.title: Frontend dependencies and workbook isolation
findings.originalTitle: Frontend dependency graph includes vulnerable spreadsheet parsing
findings.change: Upgraded dependencies, replaced vulnerable npm SheetJS with the patched distribution, and moved workbook parsing to a worker with file/row/column/time bounds.
findings.validation: 0 audit vulnerabilities; 292 frontend tests, lint and production build pass; initial JavaScript remains below 500 KB.

findings.title: Release parity gate prepared
findings.originalTitle: CI does not yet validate the remediated SDK revision
findings.change: CI now compares the checked-out SDK against the reviewed runtime-source fingerprint. Publishing the SDK commit, updating the immutable pin and running Linux/staging validation remain outstanding.
findings.validation: Local fingerprint check passes. No commit publication, Linux pipeline or staging ingress/shared-limit result is claimed.

findings.title: Token grants respect offer state
findings.originalTitle: Token creation ignores revoked/redeemed offer status
findings.change: Token issuance locks the offer, validates tenant/status/expiry and lifetime, and invalidates earlier unconsumed grants before issuing a replacement.
findings.validation: AccessTokenStore integration tests verify one-time consumption, grant rotation and invalid lifetimes.

backendFinalRun: 516 tests, zero failures, two skipped; coverage gate passed
